text:
cam: tiny vote: best 90s trip-hop / downtempo rainy afternoon playlist + one very short graphic novella (<=150p) to match? keep recs quick. :coffee:

nina: Massive Attack Mezzanine cuts + "The Arrival" (Shaun Tan) for surreal, quiet visuals. :cloud:

oscar: Portishead Dummy + "My Favorite Thing Is Monsters" (Emil Ferris) OK longer but the mini-chapters are quick to nibble. if strict: try "Asterios Polyp" excerpts. :mag:

felix: Morcheeba Big Calm for mellow grooves + "The End of the Fucking World" graphic novella? (short-ish) haha. :laughing:

cam: jukebox-bot, can you spin a 30-min "trip-drizzle" sampler mixing Massive Attack, Portishead, Morcheeba, Tricky? include at least one instrumental.

jukebox-bot: Playlist "trip-drizzle-30" created (8 tracks, ~32m). Link: https://play.example/pl/tripdrizzle30 (expires in 7 days).

nina: vote tally so far: Massive Attack (nina), Portishead (oscar), Morcheeba (felix). cam: tie-breaker?

cam: tie-breaker snack rule: whoever brings the weirdest baked good picks the graphic novella. cookies > cupcakes > stranger pies.

oscar: i will bring rosemary and olive oil crackers. borderline weird.

felix: i'll bring mini lemon tarts. safe but delightful.

nina: i can bring tea & a tiny jar of pickled plums. (yes really).

cam: meetup 4pm in the lounge for listening + comic swap. final wrap: playlist queued, snacks on the docket, graphic novella pick to be decided by snack weirdness. :headphones:
